Airlines cancel my flight from their end and never respond on refund. Worst airlines don't book your flight with this airlines. I would recommend you to book flight with Indian company if you are going somewhere from India. NokScoot is a cheater airlines
reviews.author: Naveen Kumar

reviews.title: Be careful cheating airline!!!
reviews.text: Be careful with booking of this airline!!! They offer flights, take the money and later they cancel the flight. After this they offer a voucher but even after one month no feedback or voucher. No answer at any e mails, no feedback. Therefore i warn all people, do not book this airline!!!!!!
reviews.author: Gerhard E

reviews.title: The World's Worst Airline.
reviews.text: Nok Scoot Airlines must rank as the World's Worst Airline - having unilaterally cancelled both outbound and inbound flights, attempting to gain flight credit vouchers or a refund from the so-called support team or call centre has proved impossible over a period exceeding one month. Whilst the airline demands bookings received in cash within 60 minutes in order to confirm - refunds take a mind boggling 14 weeks to process. The CAAT should revoke this carriers certification to operate in Thailand until it administers customers accounts professionally and stops pocketing booking funds making it nigh impossible to recover.
reviews.author: LindaBangkok

reviews.title: Terrible Airline, Terrible Customer Service
reviews.text: We had someone show extremely flu symptoms earlier last week, and talked to the counter about changing to the next flight out which was the next day, as we worried for our health with this passenger. They would not budge and told us we need to call the customer service hotline in order to make any changes. In the time it took me to sit on hold and finally get to someone, the plane closed its check in and I was deemed a no-show in their system. They have a COVID19 policy, but this apparently did not meet their standards and did not allow me to rebook despite their COVID19 policy. Now keep in mind the plane has not left yet. The customer service told me there was nothing they can do and I would have to rebook my flight if I wanted to do anything and no credit would be applied. The next experience was another COVID19 experience where we are flying back from BKK to Osaka, and we wanted to limit our time in Osaka. Their COVID19 policy clearly states that we would pay the difference between the flights if we are changing the dates, no problem. When we look at what we paid for our return flight vs what a new return flight would be, it equals to less than the original return flight cost (I.E. I would not have to pay anything to change the date). I am being told that I would still have to pay over 13800 yen on top of our initial flight costs for some reason. I request a travel voucher instead, and the value is 16800 yen (see how this no longer makes sense anymore? The worth my travel voucher is more than the flight). They told me it would take THREE WEEKS to process a credit. How does this even make sense? The kicker on top of all this and both customer experiences, the customer service representative tells me they are not a NOKSCOOT employee but a SCOOT employee, so their ability to do things are limited. Their phone system is either broken or useless because I selected the Nokscoot in the automated system to begin with. They also do not have the ability to transfer me to a Nokscoot employee.. Convenient.. Doesn't matter what time you call (I've called through out the day, this will happen regardless of the time) Actual flight experience: Nobody brings you a drink, not even an offer for water. They do not allow external food on the flight, and force you to buy their food. They essentially hold you hostage to pay whatever they will charge with no ifs ands or buts. I will never take this airline again and strongly urge you not to, for if you have any potential to change anything, or just an appetite on the plane, you will have to pay exorbitant prices to make it work for yourself.
reviews.author: J D

reviews.title: I wish to give ratings in negative
reviews.text: #useless Flights #TripSpoilers #IrresponsibleStaff #extremelyBadExperience Irresponsible people and staff of Nok Scoot, both domestic and International. The flight was cancelled without any notice and there is no update on refund of the ticket amount even after multiple chasers on almost everywhere on email/phone/social media. Not sure, what kind of service are they providing to their customers and howcome they are even running their business.
reviews.author: yamini

reviews.title: Good bargain airline
reviews.text: We booked this flight through Expedia. No frills business class is what we received! We were given the equivalent of a tv dinner for food. There was zero alcohol on board. We are very frequent fliers of major airlines and always fly business class. We booked a round trip flight but ended up booking business class with a major airline for our return flight. Plane was clean. Flight attendants were professional. But, if you're believing you're getting business class, you're definitely NOT! If you're on a very tight budget, book the economy seats. They don't allow you to bring any food or drinks on board. You're forced to purchase anything you'd like to consume. Booking a 7+ hour flight with zero business class amenities was a HUGE disappointment.
reviews.author: GInnyAlamo

reviews.title: Very Horrible flights
reviews.text: Staff were very rude, did not provide the water when asked for. the meals were not prebooked.I do not recommend this airlines.
reviews.author: Hasan

reviews.title: Rude cabin crew
reviews.text: Really rude cabin crew. Doesn't know how to behave. Don't understand that they not only represent their company, but also are the first look into their country. Hospitality / service sector should have better training and standards.
reviews.author: Prabhjeet S

reviews.title: Worst experience ever
reviews.text: First, I had been waiting in a long line for almost two hours (the longest ever in my life). They just opened 4 counters to check in in spite of the crowd. I understand that it's a low cost airline, so they didn't even provide some drinks on board (including water) to the passengers. The seats seemed a bit old and need a maintenance. The worst experience of all times.
reviews.author: Jackie B

reviews.title: Flight delayed 2days no any help line
reviews.text: Flight delayed 2 days .staff very rude in Delhi airport .i don’t chose agin in life.very poor service.
reviews.author: Preet

reviews.title: Useless company
reviews.text: Flight was delayed, there is no ground staff available who can answer what will be new timings for flight after rescheduling 3 times, ground staff says they don't know anything, people started beating ground staff but in reality these companies put local Indian people in ground team who is to face customer. Customer care is unreachable or try to call Singapore or Bangkok and waste your money over hold. So best practice is to invest more money and avail good carrier always and save money by travelling through public conveyance. If somebody wants to waste hardened earned money please go for this also no cabin baggage.

reviews.title: Worst experience
reviews.text: They cancelled our flight after 5 hours spending at boarding gate. We sacrificed our sleep and time and wasted money on this flight. XW305 flight worst management
reviews.author: Harsh

reviews.title: Comfortable Seat of Low Cost Airline
reviews.text: Impress the service, this is the first time for sitting more than 4 hours with Low cost Airline. I got a nice seat that i never thought of, Thanks the air ground officer that selected a good seat for me. As a low cost we always concern the leg room for the normal seat that would be uncomfortable, but NokScoot is different, I'm a really tall person 178 cm. it was comfortable seat for me. Cleanness airline and also good food (select your menu on website, price is reasonable) Service on board. I should say Nice, If you are looking for a reasonable price for 4 hours attending the flight. NokScoot from Bkk to Kanzai is a choice for you.
reviews.author: kuniam u

reviews.title: Not pretty bad
reviews.text: I felt the flight to Bangkok from Osaka was totally good, because we can quickly and cheaply access to Bangkok from other countries. Ensuring widely seat pitch was one of good point.But I felt disappointed to hear that you don't have mileage service as Air Asia and Scoot for Krisflyer.

reviews.text: Leg space was good. Flight attendants were polite and the most important flight was clean and on time.

reviews.title: Reluctance

We had to buy new flight tickets from another company, which flight goes 20 minutes later. They checked us and board us in 10 minutes.

reviews.title: This is what I think of NokScoot Buisness class
reviews.text: The Buisness class seats are smaller than the Economy class seats. I am not kidding. I know I am big. That’s why I pay more for bigger Buisness class or same seats with nobody next to me. These ones are smaller and unsafe. I don’t even have a neck rest, no arm rest. This is completely uncomfortable and in case the plane Has an accident unsafe! Report to Thai aviation and Chinese aviation is being placed.
reviews.author: Milano278

reviews.title: Low cost! Fine for short duration flights.
reviews.text: Time: Reached on time. Cost: Good for budgeted traveler but be careful while booking as baggage & food is not included. Entertainment: No source of entertainment. Comfort: The seats were small and not comfortable. The leg space was very less. I am short heighten person but I still faced the issue so tall people keep that in mind. Book Nokscoot plus for more leg space. Food: Food was not great. Water was served in a very small bottle. Announcement was in Thai language so we were not able to understand any instructions. NOTE: If you feel cold in flight, please carry a shirt or shawl as there are no blankets available.
reviews.author: Samyak Jain

reviews.title: Worst Airline I've ever flown with, Asian Ryanair.
reviews.text: Where to start. You cant check in online to start with. For a 6 hr flight there is zero inflight entertainment. No food included or water ( yes you have to buy water!) The seats are cheap and uncomfortable. Our flight was midnight, so was hoping to get some sleep, unfortunately they decided to switch on the lighting after 2hrs so they could serve a handful of people food that had booked it, while everyone else was left to suffer. Got off the flight feeling jet lagged. Business class looked no different from economy class except they kept the lights off. Can honestly say these are the worst ive flown. Stick to Air Asia.
reviews.author: Dave

reviews.title: Just stay away from Nokscoot. Bad customer service. THE WORST COMMUNICATION EVER.
reviews.text: The keep changing the flight to save their cost ( 2 times for my flight) Put customer to have no choice. There is no updated on the flight status on their website and also send me a wrong information.
reviews.author: Phataraphan Phoonsawat

reviews.title: Quality low cost
reviews.text: One good thing for flying low cost for six hours, is no one will bother you for the whole trip, where you can get a full rest. Full service is of course much better, if you fly during daytime. But for late night, I found that I can rest more in low cost.
reviews.author: Tery W

reviews.title: Cheapest flight to Bangkok
reviews.text: As a budget traveler, the experience of flying with Nok Scoot was good. The ticket was economical. They only serve water onboard free of cost. As this is a mid night flight I was happy travelling with them.
reviews.author: Akarsh J

reviews.title: Lack of Customer Service
reviews.text: I booked a roundtrip flight on Nokscoot to Japan, but they canceled the first leg of the flight and were unwilling to cancel the return trip. In order to save my vacation, I had to look for an alternative flight with a different airline. They only offered a refund as a voucher for 120% of the flight of the first leg, no cash reimbursement and no willingness to rebook us on a flight of another airline. When we took the return flight we wanted to manage our booking the website would not allow us to do add services or book seats. The app showed a blank page. We were offered to make the changes upon checkin, but were asked for much higher fees than what it would have been online. The flight itself was smooth. The aircraft was fine. For a flight over 6 hours we weren't even offered a free glass of water.
reviews.author: Micha Doy

reviews.title: 4 hr. 40 mins. delay just only McDonald's set treat No Notification, Couldn't check any update... poor
reviews.text: เครื่องออก 02:20am. ไปถึง 23:00pm. เจอป้าย delay เป็น 07:00am. โดยไม่มีการส่งข้อความแจ้งเตือนการดีเลย์ใดๆทั้ง SMS หรือ email ขอโทษด้วยการให้อาหารชุดแมคโดนัลด์ 2 ชุด ไม่สามารถรับฝากกระเป๋าเดินทางได้ ไม่สามารถออก boarding pass เลยไม่สามารถเข้าไปรอที่ lounge ได้ ตัดสินใจเรียก grab กลับบ้าน ระหว่างทางพยายามติดต่อกับทางเจ้าหน้าที่สายการบินโดยเริ่มจากโหลด application ของสายการบินแต่ก็ out of date ไปหลายปีแล้วข้อมูลต่างๆไม่ realtime โทรศัพท์หาเจ้าหน้าที่ก็เป็นเวลาปิดทำการ แต่สามารถคุยภาษาอังกฤษหรือจีนกับเจ้าหน้าที่ได้ สุดท้ายได้คุยแต่ไม่สามารถตรวจสอบอะไรได้เลย ขอบคุณเจ้าหน้าที่ประชาสัมพันธ์ของสนามบินดอนเมืองที่ตรวจสอบต่างๆให้เรียบร้อย 7 โมงเช้ากลับไปที่สนามบินอีกรอบทุกอย่างราบรื่นอย่างที่ควรจะเป็น เครื่องบินสะอาดเรียบร้อย บริการดี เครื่องบินดีเลย์สามารถรับได้แต่ควรจะใช้ technology ให้เป็นประโยชน์มีการเตือนผู้โดยสารทันทีที่ทราบว่าเครื่องดีเลย์ และให้ผู้โดยสารสามารถตรวจสอบรายละเอียดต่างๆแบบ realtime ได้ด้วย การบริการของพนักงานมาตรฐานที่ดีแต่จะไม่ใช้บริการสายบินนี้อีกถ้าไม่จำเป็นจริงๆ ก็เพราะระบบการบริหารจัดการที่ไม่มีประสิทธิภาพ
reviews.author: Noppadol P

reviews.title: Awful
reviews.text: Check in staff was nice however the luggage charges were bogus. In flight staff was rude and pestering. People were packed in like sardines. Just an awful experience don’t book through them!
reviews.author: Zeus

reviews.title: Very good aircraft
reviews.text: Flight was on time. Check in was smooth. Cabin crew were young. Leg space in economy class was not enough for me as I am 6 feet in height. Food was not complementary. There were very few options for vegetarians. Overall experience is good.
reviews.author: Parvesh V

reviews.title: Flight departs on time
reviews.text: Following a 3 hour delay on Nokscoot from Bangkok to Osaka on 18 July, I'm happy to report that the return flight from Osaka to Don Mueang on 27 July departed on time. Seats in the extra leg-room zone (silent zone) are fantastic and beat all economy seats on mainline carriers that I've been on. The plane was probably 30 % full so there was plenty of space to stretch out. Staff were quick to get people to buckle up when the seat-belt sign was on. Overall a good flight experience.
reviews.author: Rory T

reviews.title: Delayed flight.
reviews.text: There was No mention of the delayed flight to Osaka tonight when I checked in which really doesn't reflect well on this airline. The flight has been delayed for 3 hours and there's been no communication by airline staff to the best of my knowledge. Hopefully this won't happen on the return flight!
reviews.author: Rory T

reviews.title: Unprofessional airlines

Rescheduled my flight twice in a week because of which i had to cancel my hotel booking and then again had to book it because they rescheduled it again... And their is no way they would compensate for the time you wasted and energy and money... They only give you option to rebook or refund thats it... Pathetic service... Its the st and last time i booked nokscoot... Dont recommend it to anyone at all...

reviews.title: Overall good experience
reviews.text: Quite smooth experience from booking tickets to buying extra baggage to check in and in-flight experience. Generous seat pitch and leg room. Not too old aircraft. Comfy and clean. Courteous ground staff and cabin crew. On time departure and arrival.
reviews.author: Prabhjeet S

reviews.title: Very comfortable flight.
reviews.text: Flight is comfortable. Leg space is good for a tall person like me. I prefer booking the seats before itself. Staff is polite and helpful though they seemed like uncomfortable with fluent English. Overall a recommended flight.
reviews.author: jayant_bhalla

reviews.title: all glitter & no gold
reviews.text: from where to start. i am a frequent traveller & understand the concept of a low cost carrier.the plane was good ,on time etc but the ground staff & hostesses were very rude.why does indian govt allow such airlines to operate who dont even serve water in flight.we were not aware & wre not carrying any.they just provide you with a small 100 ml cup of complimentery water for the whole night long journey.pay more if you need more& that too exorbitant.being holiday season i could see kids begging for drinking water but the hostesses just wont oblidge.they snatch ur bottles of water bought frm airport.this airlines should be named extortion airways.i will also file a formal complaint with the civil aviation ministry.guys if ur spending so much on a vacation then spend a couple of thousand more & go by our local carriers like indigo,spice etc. at least they are more human.
reviews.author: dps0049bhatia

reviews.title: Treat people like cattle in real!
reviews.text: Took this flight as had flown on a domestic flight in Thailand earlier on Nok air and thought it would be as good as the domestic one. Was travelling with my two young daughters on the red eye service to Bangkok. The aircraft being used on this sector is old and tattered. The worst crew I have ever encountered. I am usually quite conservative with my critique but the crew on this particular flight on 14th June were exceptionally bad and rude. The biggest mistake I did was not to buy water before boarding as I was made to feel like a beggar to ask water for my little daughter . I asked for water as soon as I boarded the flight as my daughter just wanted to have water and sleep as it was already 2:30 am but the crew told me that water will be given only after take off. I waited for the crew to give water after seat belt sign was switched off but no one came so went to the rear galley to request for a glass but was rudely told that go back to Ur seat and we will give water later. I requested that my lil daughter was very thirsty and I could take back for her but to no avail. I had to return back. We were finally given a small cup but this terrible apathy shown by crew on that flight left a very bad experience. I complained to the supervisor later and she was apologetic and even offered us some more water! Overall the crew operating this flight were abrupt, even while securing the cabin they do not give people time to settle down and even when seat belt sign is not even switched on they restrict people from using toilets and are very aggressive. They do not speak English or pretend not to when someone tries to talk to them . They treated Indians very badly. Would not like to travel again on this flight unless I had no choice whatsoever.
reviews.author: 14amritak

reviews.title: Very bad website and call center does not pick phone in Thailand
reviews.text: Was trying to book baggage before flying out and my credit card was continually declined. Called my credit card company and everything was in order. Tried another card same result. Finally after many attempts called the call center, which was equally worse. No one picked the call. Guess will have to pay the 200 additional bhat at the airport. Avoid the airline, with baggage fee , etc could have flown a better airline, who have service levels in place.
reviews.author: Navin S

reviews.title: Online services need improvement and extra charges
reviews.text: Wednesday departure, 220am flight, 6.5 hrs journey Changing of flight - Booked my ticket using Scoot website, and I didn’t know that it would be a Nokscoot flight. When I wanted to change my flight date, Nokscoot wanted to charge me a full ticket price (3000 baht) whereas for a Scoot flight, it would be price difference and service fees. Called customer hotline to try to switch to the earlier scoot flight, as Nokscoot doesn’t allow me to switch to Scoot flight. Different websites. Felt cheated. BAD experience. Online payment for add-ons - Horrible experience, I wasted 40 mins using 5 different bank cards but all were decline. The amount is 1550 baht, but that somehow triggered a security alert by Nokscoot, which declined ALL my attempts for payment. In the end, I had to pay at the airport counter and was charged 200 baht for counter service fees. When I raised my unhappiness, the counter lady gave me a hotline number and told me either I pay the 200 baht or I call the number. BAD customer service. Check-in - I went there 3 hrs before flight time, and the screen indicated that it was row 3. Together with the flight to China. After 35 mins queueing, I was told that the row was servicing China flight as indicated on top of the check-in counter. When I checked the screen again, it was shown row 6 for Narita flight. Counter staff was lovely, had a pleasant experience. Flight - It was a mid-week flight, hence the aircraft was not totally filled. Some seat covers were badly worn out. Otherwise it was an average budget flight. I pre-ordered breakfast, which was served at 6am. Upon hindsight, food was not required for this flight. Save your money please. Overall - I know it is a Budget flight, but the overall experience leaves a bad taste in my mouth. It’s not the extra money that I had to spend, but the time wasted and inconvenience. I would recommend another company for a more pleasant experience.
reviews.author: Fleeflyfox

reviews.title: Above average experience on board flight 306
reviews.text: I flew from Bangkok to Delhi with family on 28th May'19 NokScoot flight no. 306. It was an average experience. There was a long queue at the check in counter even before check in was started. The airline staff only arrived 3 hours before the flight departure time. The aircraft is big and economy seats have decent space however, the food items mentioned in menu were not available. I could only get a veg salad as none of the veg items mentioned in the menu were available. The flight was on time which was a good thing. Overall the experience was above average with NokScoot but given the cheaper price of tickets of this airline i won't mind flying again with them.
reviews.author: Abhishek Sharma, PMP

reviews.title: Baggage scam
reviews.text: They charged me an extra 65$ for my baggage on the airport. Try to get the check in done the morning of the flight but apparently you need more than 24 hours from your departure time (which was 42$ instead) wouldn't recommend this airline to anyone
reviews.author: dean

reviews.title: Awesome - N.O.T. !!!!!
reviews.text: After buying a biz class return ticket to Tokyo, on the condition that I could change my return date, I was told that I could, for a fee of $65 usd. , change the return date. Being acceptable, I agreed. Upon needing to return to Bangkok earlier, I was informed that I could travel on an economy seat as there was no availability in Biz on my date. However, the fee would be the $65 aforementioned + a fare adjustment of aprox $350. So adding $415, I had to agree. At check-in I was informed that I was lucky as there were still 3 seats vacant in biz. Ok!, I said. - For that though, Pay an additional $80. ( I choose biz as I am 2mts. tall, and cannot fit in low cost economy seats) My return ticket price to Japan now literally nearly doubled! - Seats were of nice leather, but of a cheap foam core and poorly designed in terms of support. Water-no, blanket-no, screen-no. I wanted to purchase water but they didn't accept larger size notes in any currency and no credit cards neither for drinks and snacks! I won't even get into the horrible bright yellow with black designed mini dresses on the only under 25 female staff!! Never again Nokscoot! Awesome - NOT !!!!
reviews.author: Efi H

reviews.title: Good experience at affordable prices
reviews.text: Airlines provides tickets at a very budget price. And experience was similar to other airlines companies. We were happy to have chosen Nokscoot and save a lot of money on our travel.
reviews.author: Nikunj Aggarwal

reviews.title: Worst of the worst
reviews.text: Always delay - outsoursing check in counter (no staff from Nok Scoot). Unable to contact for any responsibilities - only things they provide is 2 voucher value 250nt for 2 meals in compensation for delayed 12 hrs.
reviews.author: Win

reviews.title: Reasonably Priced NonStop Flight to Delhi
reviews.text: Nice but simple planes; friendly staff; good communications. I traveled from DMK to DEL in March 2019. Check in was a bit crowded but staff was friendly. Did not give any hassle about carry on baggage. Did not weigh the pieces on both ways. Return flight was delayed by three hours, but the airline notified three days in advance, which was nice. Will travel again without any hesitation.
reviews.author: 935satnams

reviews.title: Delayed flight, terrible customer service
reviews.text: I would not recommend this airline. The money you might save is not worth the potential (likely) trouble. Our flight to Delhi from Bangkok was delayed 8 hours. There was no communication about the delay, and even after we checked in for our flight, the flight status page on the airport’s website confirmed the flight was ‘on time’ when clearly that was not correct. We received a food voucher for the trouble which my husband and I were fine with because lucky for us the delay didn’t cause us much inconvenience. We were told at check in that the voucher could be used either before or after passing through security. We wandered around the airport before going through security and found that out of all the restaurants, we could only use the voucher for a meal deal at either Burger King or McDonald’s. And what’s more, only for a beef meal deal (no chicken or fish). Remember this is a flight going to India where most people don’t eat beef... Anyway, we didn’t feel like either of those options so we passed through security and started going from food outlet to food outlet, each time being told our voucher wasn’t accepted. Finally we gave up and went to a McDonald’s we found (we figured that was a sure thing since the one before security accepted the voucher), but of course this one didn’t. We met up out front of the McDonald’s with over a dozen other passengers having the same problem of finding dinner as us. A representative from the airline came to our group to let us know that in fact our only options to redeem our voucher were mango sticky rice (not dinner) or a tiny mystery meat sandwich in a plastic box (also not dinner). I understand flight delays happen, but this airline could have done so much more to at least give passengers a decent meal to compensate for their lost time and disruption to their travel plans. Simple measures like communicating flight delays and giving people proper meal vouchers would have made this 8 hour delay so much more bearable. Will not fly with this airline again.
reviews.author: Olivia R

reviews.title: Worst Airlines with smell of Toilets  in the all the flight
reviews.text: On of the worst an smelly flight, Moreover Indian travelers also spreads more dirtiness by talking loudly and badly Does not suggested to any one to travel on this Flight.I had booked the Flight via MakeMyTrip.com and at the time of check-IN I had to pay extra for the luggage as MakeMyTrip.com is the worst website to book this Flight
reviews.author: sankalpsaxena7

reviews.title: The worst flight experience I have ever had.
reviews.text: My friend and I were traveling to Bangkok from Dehli. Unfortunately as can happen our flight was delayed by 21 houres, this if of course not a big issue, however we were given no information on what hotel we were being taken to and what our rights where. We had received no notification on our flight being delayed or what would be happening later. We found out the next day from our hotel staff, (who are not connected to this nokscoot) that our flight had been cancelled. Not from nokscoot emails or notifications. When I called we were given 3options book again but wait 7days. Get a refund which would take 6-8weeks or get vouchers for flying which would also arrive in 6-8weeks. And they would not pay for accommodation or food during this week. Luckily I had some extra money to book a new flight however if I had been on the last leg of my trip with no money, that would have been it for me. It is unacceptable for a company to treat their customers with such little regard. The only upside is that the ground crew was polite as the hurried us of with no information. I will never fly with them again. I would have been stuck at the airport again if it had not been for the lovely staff at our hotel.

reviews.title: Don't book this airlines,pathetic service
reviews.text: This airline has pathetic service.I am travelling from this flight on 9 feb 2019.When i reach airport,airport staff has informed us that flight is delayed by 21 hours.The atitude and way of talking to passengers is pathetic.Airlines have told that they will provide accomdation in good hotel.They booked hotel Arch for next 21 hours.When we reached to the hotel,they have shifted us to the another hotel which is in backsteert in mahipalpur,hotel anadlok,however the good part is that they have provided the 3 time meal which is satisfactory but you have to walk from hotel anadlok to hotel arch. My one day hotel and taxi booking has been wasted and airline did not compensate for that.They simply say"THIS IS A LOW COST AIRLINE,ANYTHING CAN HAPPEN". I request all the people please be careful while booking this airlines.Also, they say it is a low fare lines..the difference on the to and fro ticket is 3000 only...Hence please take flight from some branded vendors like indigo, spicejet,air asia, jet airways.
reviews.author: vibhu agarwal

reviews.title: This company is a shame
reviews.text: I took a flight yesterday evening it was totally empty. On one side is good to sleep but on the other one it's a shame for the environment. All the raws were empty and it was a huge Boeing 777. I thinks we were maximum 50 people. At Bangkok airport before taking off it took a while like 30 minutes. And then in Delhi maybe 50 minutes after the landing before being able to go out. They were saying that the plane cannot park!?! Even with only 50 people the service was not good. At the end no one to say goodbye. At the end the day after I notice I forgot a bag. I spent 50 minutes on the phone with the office of Delhi in order at the end they tell me that I have to call Singapore for an item lost in Delhi! I will never take this company again...
reviews.author: SoniaColla

reviews.title: Comfortable
reviews.text: NokScoot Airlines is a Thailand-based low-cost airline. It operates international services out of Bangkok's Don Mueang International Airport. I experienced both their business and economy class and I must say both were very comfortable flights. Also they have a vast menu to choose from for your meals and the food served is hot and delicious. Staff is friendly and the flight was on time. Looking forward to flying with them again :)
